hooks.command: file="$(echo $CODEBUDDY_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("file_path",""))')"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE 'kb/.*bugcard.*\.yaml$'; then python3 "${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../common/hooks/validators/bugcard_validator.py" "$file"; fi
hooks.description: BugCard 写入知识库前自动完整性检查（12 项规则）

hooks.command: file="$(echo $CODEBUDDY_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("file_path",""))')"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE 'skeptic_.*\.yaml$'; then python3 "${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../common/hooks/validators/skeptic_signoff_checker.py" "$file"; fi
hooks.description: Skeptic 签署文件写入后格式验证（五把刀覆盖检查）

hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess, sys, json

# 检查是否是结案场景
try:
    input_data = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
    msg = input_data.get('assistant_message', '')
except:
    msg = ''

if any(k in msg for k in ['最终裁决', '根因确认', '结案', 'VALIDATED']):
    r1 = subprocess.run(['python3', '${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../common/hooks/validators/counterfactual_validator.py', 'session_evidence.yaml'], capture_output=True)
    r2 = subprocess.run(['python3', '${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../common/hooks/validators/skeptic_signoff_checker.py', 'skeptic_signoff.yaml'], capture_output=True)
    if r1.returncode != 0 or r2.returncode != 0:
        print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': '❌ 结案条件未满足：反事实验证或 Skeptic 签署不完整，请补充后重试。'}))
        sys.exit(0)
"
hooks.description: 结案前检查反事实验证记录与 Skeptic 签署状态
